title: LLM Provider Integrations
summary: This module defines an abstract interface for Large Language Model (LLM) providers and implements concrete classes for integrating with various LLM APIs, handling authentication, client instantiation, and model-specific configurations.

nodes.label: Abstract LLM Provider Interface
nodes.title: Provider
nodes.description: Defines the common interface for all LLM providers, including properties for name, base URL, client, and a static method for model profiling. Manages HTTP client lifecycle.

nodes.label: Alibaba Cloud Provider
nodes.title: AlibabaProvider
nodes.description: Integrates with Alibaba Cloud Model Studio (DashScope) OpenAI-compatible API, providing an AsyncOpenAI client and specific model profiling for Qwen models.

nodes.label: Anthropic API Provider
nodes.title: AnthropicProvider
nodes.description: Integrates with the Anthropic API, providing an AsyncAnthropicClient and specific model profiling for Anthropic models, including Bedrock variants.

nodes.label: Azure OpenAI Provider
nodes.title: AzureProvider
nodes.description: Integrates with Azure OpenAI API, providing an AsyncOpenAI client and model profiling for various models hosted on Azure, including Meta, DeepSeek, Mistral, Cohere, Grok, and OpenAI models.

nodes.label: Cerebras API Provider
nodes.title: CerebrasProvider
nodes.description: Integrates with Cerebras API, providing an AsyncOpenAI client and model profiling for Llama, Qwen, GPT-OSS, and ZAI models, with specific handling for unsupported OpenAI features.

nodes.label: Cohere API Provider
nodes.title: CohereProvider
nodes.description: Integrates with Cohere API, providing AsyncClientV2 and AsyncClient (V1) clients, and model profiling for Cohere models.

nodes.label: DeepSeek API Provider
nodes.title: DeepSeekProvider
nodes.description: Integrates with DeepSeek API, providing an AsyncOpenAI client and model profiling with specific settings for JSON object output, thinking fields, and tool choice.

nodes.label: Fireworks AI Provider
nodes.title: FireworksProvider
nodes.description: Integrates with Fireworks AI API, providing an AsyncOpenAI client and model profiling for Llama, Qwen, DeepSeek, Mistral, and Gemma models.

nodes.label: GitHub Models Provider
nodes.title: GitHubProvider
nodes.description: Integrates with GitHub Models API, providing an OpenAI-compatible client and model profiling for various LLMs including xAI, Meta, Microsoft, Mistral, Cohere, and DeepSeek.

nodes.label: Grok API Provider (xAI)
nodes.title: GrokProvider
nodes.description: Integrates with Grok API (xAI's OpenAI-compatible interface), providing an AsyncOpenAI client and model profiling, noting lack of strict tool definition support.

nodes.label: Groq API Provider
nodes.title: GroqProvider
nodes.description: Integrates with Groq API, providing an AsyncGroq client and model profiling for Llama, Gemma, Qwen, DeepSeek, Mistral, MoonshotAI, Compound, and OpenAI models.

nodes.label: Heroku API Provider
nodes.title: HerokuProvider
nodes.description: Integrates with Heroku API, providing an OpenAI-compatible client and a generic model profile.

nodes.label: Hugging Face Provider
nodes.title: HuggingFaceProvider
nodes.description: Integrates with Hugging Face Inference API, providing an AsyncInferenceClient and model profiling for DeepSeek, Google, Qwen, Meta Llama, Mistral, and MoonshotAI models.

nodes.label: LiteLLM Proxy Provider
nodes.title: LiteLLMProvider
nodes.description: Acts as a proxy provider using LiteLLM, providing an AsyncOpenAI client and routing model profiles to various underlying providers like Anthropic, OpenAI, Google, Mistral, Cohere, Amazon, Meta, Groq, DeepSeek, MoonshotAI, xAI, and Qwen.

nodes.label: Mistral API Provider
nodes.title: MistralProvider
nodes.description: Integrates with Mistral API, providing a Mistral client and model profiling for Mistral models.

nodes.label: MoonshotAI Provider
nodes.title: MoonshotAIProvider
nodes.description: Integrates with MoonshotAI platform (Kimi models), providing an AsyncOpenAI client and model profiling with specific settings for JSON object output and thinking parts.

nodes.label: Nebius AI Studio Provider
nodes.title: NebiusProvider
nodes.description: Integrates with Nebius AI Studio API, providing an AsyncOpenAI client and model profiling for Meta Llama, DeepSeek, Qwen, Google, OpenAI (gpt-oss), Mistral, and MoonshotAI models.

nodes.label: Ollama API Provider
nodes.title: OllamaProvider
nodes.description: Integrates with local or remote Ollama API, providing an AsyncOpenAI client and model profiling for Llama, Gemma, Qwen, DeepSeek, Mistral, Command, and GPT-OSS models, with native JSON schema support.

nodes.label: OpenAI API Provider
nodes.title: OpenAIProvider
nodes.description: Integrates directly with the OpenAI API, providing an AsyncOpenAI client and model profiling for OpenAI models.

nodes.label: Outlines Structured Output Provider
nodes.title: OutlinesProvider
nodes.description: Provides an interface for models that support structured output via the Outlines library, without a specific base URL or client, focusing on JSON schema and object output capabilities.

nodes.label: OVHcloud AI Endpoints Provider
nodes.title: OVHcloudProvider
nodes.description: Integrates with OVHcloud AI Endpoints, providing an AsyncOpenAI client and model profiling for Llama, DeepSeek, Mistral, GPT, and Qwen models.

nodes.label: SambaNova AI Provider
nodes.title: SambaNovaProvider
nodes.description: Integrates with SambaNova AI models via an OpenAI-compatible API, providing an AsyncOpenAI client and model profiling for DeepSeek, Meta Llama, Qwen, and Mistral models.

nodes.label: Together AI Provider
nodes.title: TogetherProvider
nodes.description: Integrates with Together AI API, providing an AsyncOpenAI client and model profiling for DeepSeek, Google, Qwen, Meta Llama, and Mistral models.

nodes.label: Vercel AI Gateway Provider
nodes.title: VercelProvider
nodes.description: Integrates with Vercel AI Gateway API, providing an AsyncOpenAI client and model profiling for Anthropic, Bedrock, Cohere, DeepSeek, Mistral, OpenAI, Vertex, and xAI models.

nodes.label: VoyageAI Provider
nodes.title: VoyageAIProvider
nodes.description: Integrates with VoyageAI API, providing an AsyncClient for embedding models.

nodes.label: xAI Native SDK Provider
nodes.title: XaiProvider
nodes.description: Integrates with xAI API using its native SDK, providing an AsyncClient and model profiling for Grok models.

nodes.label: Qwen Bedrock Profile
nodes.title: bedrock_qwen_model_profile
nodes.description: Generates a ModelProfile for Qwen models when accessed via AWS Bedrock, including specific JSON schema transformer and structured output support.

nodes.label: Anthropic Bedrock Profile
nodes.title: bedrock_anthropic_model_profile
nodes.description: Generates a ModelProfile for Anthropic models when accessed via AWS Bedrock, including tool choice, thinking parts, and adaptive thinking support.

nodes.label: Amazon Bedrock Profile
nodes.title: bedrock_amazon_model_profile
nodes.description: Generates a ModelProfile for Amazon models (e.g., Titan, Nova) when accessed via AWS Bedrock, including tool choice and prompt caching support.

nodes.label: Mistral Bedrock Profile
nodes.title: bedrock_mistral_model_profile
nodes.description: Generates a ModelProfile for Mistral models when accessed via AWS Bedrock, including tool result format and structured output support.

nodes.label: Google Bedrock Profile
nodes.title: bedrock_google_model_profile
nodes.description: Generates a ModelProfile for Google models when accessed via AWS Bedrock, including structured output support and limitations on JSON object mode and tool return schemas.

nodes.label: MiniMax Bedrock Profile
nodes.title: bedrock_minimax_model_profile
nodes.description: Generates a ModelProfile for MiniMax models when accessed via AWS Bedrock, including structured output support.

nodes.label: NVIDIA Bedrock Profile
nodes.title: bedrock_nvidia_model_profile
nodes.description: Generates a ModelProfile for NVIDIA models when accessed via AWS Bedrock, including structured output support.

nodes.label: OpenRouter Google Profile
nodes.title: _openrouter_google_model_profile
nodes.description: Generates a ModelProfile for Google models accessed via OpenRouter, using a legacy JSON schema transformer for compatibility.

nodes.label: OpenRouter Google JSON Schema Adapter
nodes.title: _OpenRouterGoogleJsonSchemaTransformer
nodes.description: A legacy JSON schema transformer specifically for OpenRouter's compatibility layer with Google models, inlining definitions and simplifying nullable unions.

nodes.label: MoonshotAI Groq Profile
nodes.title: groq_moonshotai_model_profile
nodes.description: Generates a ModelProfile for MoonshotAI models when used with the Groq provider, enabling JSON object and schema output.

nodes.label: Meta Groq Profile
nodes.title: meta_groq_model_profile
nodes.description: Generates a ModelProfile for Meta models when used with the Groq provider, enabling JSON object and schema output for specific Llama models.
